bound_interpretation: Finite-panel identification bounds, conditional on correctness of the explicitly chosen positive line judgments and (when named) sound gold. Invalid criticism never supplies a nonfalse-line label. Unknown lines share indicators across models on the same item. No sampling confidence, population extrapolation, or generated-explanation bound is claimed.
joint_endpoint_definition: Protocol-valid attempt AND J1=YES AND J3 in {kernel-valid,exact-valid,analytic-valid}. All modes secondary; original primary J3 table unchanged.
